sentences.text: By way of this application preferred under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 ['Cr.P.C.', for short] , the applicant has sought his release on anticipatory bail in event of his arrest in respect of FIR being No.11191042230169 of 2023 registered with Satellite Police Station for offences punishable under Sections 406, 420, 102(b) and 506 of Indian Penal Code.
2. Rule.
Learned Additional Public Prosecutor Mr. Utkarsh Sharma waives service of notice of Rule on behalf of respondent State.

Heard learned advocate Mr.Yatin Soni for the applicant and learned Additional Public Prosecutor Mr.Utkarsh Sharma for the respondent State.
4.1

As per the FIR registered by the complainant viz. Dr.Bansilal Damodarlal Sabu, on 18.04.2023 he purchased 1 kg of gold from Bharat Soni and as such the gold biscuits were delivered to him by accused Bharat Soni.
He purchased gold biscuits from Bharat Soni for the reason that said Bharat Kirtibhai Shantilal Soni vs State Of Gujarat on 21 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/3789313/

sentences.text: 1 Soni and his wife used to come to his clinic for treatment of father of Bharat Soni.

Though the biscuits were delivered but there was no hallmark on the biscuits, the complainant on 27.04.2020 informed the accused Bharat Soni about the same and accused Bharat Soni told him that tomorrow i.e. on 28.04.2023 he would get the whole- marking of the biscuits done.

On 28.04.2023, accused Bharat Soni came to the complainant and complainant told him to go to his residence with staff member of the complainant viz. Piyush Parmar to get those gold biscuits for hallmarking from his wife.
However, the accused Bharat Soni without taking Piyush Parmar with R/CR.MA/10266/2023 ORDER DATED: 21/06/2023 him collected the gold biscuits from wife of the complainant.

When the complainant called and asked Bharat Soni as to why he went to his residence without taking Piyush Parmar with him, he told that the procedure for getting hallmarked would take 2-3 hours and, therefore, he directly collected it.

As the gold biscuits did not reach the complainant, when he called Bharat Soni again, he told that his brother Kirtibhai Shantilal Soni i.e. present applicant shall take hallmarked gold biscuits to their shops and the same shall be delivered in the evening.
When the complainant offered to send his own person, Bharat Soni said 'No' for that and assured that biscuits shall be delivered by evening.

4.2 However, for one reason or another the gold biscuits were not delivered back to the complainant till the next date i.e. 29.04.2023 and he also stopped receiving his call and switched off his mobile and, therefore, on 29.04.2023 in the morning the complainant sent one of his staff members viz.
Abhilashaben to ensure at the residence of Bharat Soni R/CR.MA/10266/2023 ORDER DATED:
21/06/2023 who found that Bharat Soni has left his residence since previous day at around 11:30 on 28.04.2023

. Ultimately, when the complainant inquired about main accused Bharat Soni through his wife, who is co- accused and his brother i.e. present applicant, they did not give any satisfactory reply and present applicant continued saying that he has not received any phone call from accused Bharat Soni.

4.3 On the same day at night, the complainant had talked with the present applicant Kirtibhai Soni who told the complainant that he has received call from friend of Bharat Soni informing that his phone is damaged and he would come by tomorrow but did not give details about with whom he (Kirtibhai Soni) talked or what was the number wherefrom he got whereabouts of Bharat Soni.
4.4 On 01.05.2023, when the complainant called present applicant Kirtibhai, he told him to call him after two hours.
Therefore, once Kirtibhai reached at shop, staff member of the complainant Piyush Parmar was sent to his shop and from there present accused R/CR.MA/10266/2023 ORDER DATED: 21/06/2023

Kirtibhai had a telephonic conversations with the complainant wherein he said that he had talked with Bharatbhai Soni and he ( Bharatbhai ) would call the complainant and also asked as to why the complainant sent his staff member to the shop.
When the complainant asked him to give him call back, he said Bharat Soni would call you and asked staff member of complainant viz. Piyush Parmar to leave the shop.
4.5 Thereafter in the evening at around 3:30 Bharat Soni gave miss-call to the complainant on whatsapp and in response thereto when complainant tried to call him, he did not pick up phone.
Thereafter Bharatbhai messaged the complainant that he is at Dubai and thereafter he switched off the phone.

Thereafter when the complainant called Kirtibhai i.e. present applicant, he got angry and Kirtibhai Shantilal Soni vs State Of Gujarat on 21 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/3789313/
2 threatened the complainant asking him to do whatever complainant wanted to do and threatened him not to call him again else he would file police complaint for harassment.

sentences.text: 4.6 Even co-accused Manishaben Bharatbhai Soni despite being contacted again and again did not give R/CR.MA/10266/2023 ORDER DATED: 21/06/2023 satisfactory reply and she also misbehaved with the complainant on call on 04.05.2023.

She also made phone call to complainant on 13.05.2023 and threatened him that she would see to it that complainant get disreputed in society and he may find difficult to run the clinic and, therefore, despite the complainant purchased gold biscuits of 1 kg worth Rs.59,50,000/- till date of complaint those biscuits were not given back to the complainant and as such said Bharat Soni, his wife Manishaben Soni and present applicant Kirtibhai Soni conspired and cheated the complainant, the complaint was registered.

5.1 Learned advocate Mr.Yatin Soni for the applicant made lengthy submissions and submitted that the gold biscuits were purchased by the complainant from Bharatbhai Soni, who happened to the brother of the present applicant and the present applicant is absolutely innocent person being unaware about the entire transaction.

He submitted that even as per the FIR, it was Bharatbhai Soni only who collected biscuits from the residence of the complainant for hallmarking R/CR.MA/10266/2023 ORDER DATED: 21/06/2023 and thereafter fled away to Dubai.

The present applicant was not at all in the picture till 28.04.2022 evening when for the first time he was contacted by the complainant as Bharat Soni did not return gold biscuits after hallmarking despite collecting the same on 28.04.2023.

5.2 Learned advocate Mr.Soni also pointed out the fact that though gold biscuits were taken by main accused Bharat Soni on 28.04.2023, the complaint was registered almost after 25 days i.e. on 25.05.2023 and, therefore, considering the role of the present applicant, who happens to be brother of the main accused who is not actively participated in the offence and he was not the person who ran away with gold biscuits and being reputed person in the society running jewelry shop, he is required to be granted anticipatory bail.

5.3 Learned advocate Mr.Soni further submitted that co-accused viz. Minaben @ Manisaben Bharatkumar Soni, who happens to be the wife of main accused Bharat Soni is already granted anticipatory bail by the trial Court and therefore considering the role of the R/CR.MA/10266/2023 ORDER DATED: 21/06/2023 present applicant as that of Minaben @ Manisha Bharat Soni, on the ground of parity also he is required to be granted anticipatory bail.
5.4
Learned advocate Mr.Soni further submitted that maximum punishment in case if the applicant is held guilty of offences would be of seven years and, therefore, looking to the series of judgments

,
the present applicant is required to be granted anticipatory bail.

sentences.text: 5.5 Learned advocate Mr.Soni submitted that present applicant be granted anticipatory bail.
5.6 No other submissions are made, nor any further authorities are relied upon.

6.1 Learned Additional Public Prosecutor Mr.Utkarsh Sharma vehemently opposed the bail application and submitted that the present applicant is the conspirator and hence he has been arraigned as co- accused.

Learned Additional Public Prosecutor Mr.Sharma pointed out from an application filed by the wife of main accused Bharat Soni viz. Minaben @ Manisaben Bharatkumar Soni dated 05.04.2023 that the present applicant and main accused Bharat Soni were working in the same shop which is owned by his family.
They are into family business of goldsmith and they do not have any separate shop and therefore they are sitting in the same shop and working separately.

The aforesaid application made by the wife addressing R/CR.MA/10266/2023 ORDER DATED:
21/06/2023 to Police Commissioner Ahmedabad also states that both brothers are residing in joint family in same premises and it was also pointed out from the aforesaid application that the date on which the accused Bharatbhai Soni went missing the wife of Bharat Soni first made phone call to his friend and other persons till midnight and though present applicant was residing under the same roof, in the same premises, he was contacted only after midnight which according to learned APP Mr.Sharma is not believable, prima facie, as when two brothers are residing in the same premises and one brother goes missing
, as natural consequence the younger brother would be informed about the same but complaint of the wife suggested that he was contacted last.

sentences.text: It was further pointed out by learned Additional Public Prosecutor that at no point of time present applicant has pleaded ignorance about any transaction entered into between the complainant and brother of the present applicant viz. Bharat Soni.

Though the present applicant was aware about the fact that main R/CR.MA/10266/2023 ORDER DATED: 21/06/2023 accused Bharat Soni has fled away to Dubai, every moment he gave false promises to the complainant that the gold has reached at his shop and the same shall be delivered.

6.3 Learned Additional Public Prosecutor further pointed out that if the present applicant was not a conspirator, from the day one he could have said that he was absolutely unaware about the transaction and as such neither he was responsible for the transaction entered into between the complainant and Bharat Soni nor for his brother Bharat Soni fleeing away to Dubai.

Instead of taking this stand, the present applicant continuously kept on giving false promises to the complainant which would indicate that he was aware about the transaction and he is one of the active participants in the conspiracy.

6.4 Learned Additional Public Prosecutor submitted that as the present applicant and his brother were carrying on business in the same shop and are staying together in the same premises, it is difficult to believe that the present applicant was unaware about the R/CR.MA/10266/2023 ORDER DATED: 21/06/2023 entire transaction.

He further submitted that considering the fact that main accused Bharat Soni has already fled away to Dubai, co-accused i.e. wife of Bharat Soni being lady accused is granted anticipatory bail, the custodial interrogation of the present applicant is necessitated.
If the present applicant too is granted anticipatory bail then in absence of custodial interrogation truth would never be surfaced and ultimately the offence shall remain undetected and,

therefore, he submitted that looking to the overall facts and circumstances and considering the fact that the present applicant is residing together with the main accused and carrying on business in the same shop and has all throughout given false promises, he being one of the conspirator of the conspiracy should not be granted anticipatory bail.
4. I have heard learned advocates for the respective parties and perused the record.

On perusal of the record I find that even in a complaint about harassment addressed to the police commissioner,
the wife of the main accused Bharat Soni has accepted the R/CR.MA/10266/2023 ORDER DATED:
21/06/2023 fact that the gold was purchased by the complainant from his husband i.e. Bharat Soni and same was not hallmarked and, therefore, he collected the gold for hallmarking and thereafter never gave it back to the complainant and fled away to Dubai.
As aforesaid facts are undisputed, the role of the present applicant becomes significant.

Considering the fact that the present applicant happens to be brother of the main accused carrying on business in the same shop and staying together and more particularly looking to his conduct that all throughout when he could have pleaded ignorance about any transaction took place between the complainant and his brother, he has given only false promises and replied that gold has reached the shop and the same shall be delivered to the complainant, prima facie shows his involvement in the offence in question.
To what extend the present applicant is involved in the offence is a matter of investigation.

Considering the fact that today since the main accused has fled away to Dubai and his wife is granted anticipatory bail by the trial Court, the present applicant is the only accused who is though aware R/CR.MA/10266/2023 ORDER DATED: 21/06/2023 about the crime and conspiracy hatched, if he Kirtibhai Shantilal Soni vs State Of Gujarat on 21 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/3789313/
5 is also granted anticipatory bail, in that case, there is strong possibility that the offence would never be investigated and detected properly in the manner in which it should be. Therefore, considering the fact that present applicant is residing together, he is doing business together in same shop and considering the overall conduct of the present applicant, this Court is of the view that looking to the nature of offence, considering the knowledge about the offence as well as considering the fact that the present applicant has given false promise to the complainant despite his knowledge about offence, prima facie, it appears that the present applicant is involved in the offence in question and,
therefore, in absence of main accused, who happens to be real brother of the present applicant who has fled away to Dubai, the custodial interrogation of the present applicant would be required and,
therefore, considering the aforesaid aspects, the present application requires to be dismissed as there is prima facie case against the present applicant.

sentences.text: For the reasons recorded above, the present application is dismissed.
Rule is discharged.
No order as to costs.

6.1 After the aforesaid order is passed, learned advocate Mr.Yatin Soni requests that in view of the fact that applicants seek to challenge this order before the Hon'ble Supreme Court by way of preferring Special Leave Petition, the applicants should not be arrested for a period of four weeks.
For the reasons recorded above and considering the facts of the case, this request is not acceded to.
6.2 Learned advocate Mr.Soni further requests that since the important question of law is involved in this matter, leave may be granted the applicants to file Special Leave Petition.
However, this Court is of the view that there is no important question of law involved in this matter and the matter is decided on the basis of the facts of the case.
Therefore, no such leave is required to be granted.
It is rejected accordingly.

(NIRZAR S. DESAI,J) MISHRA AMIT V.
